data.description:
Demi-humans are creatures that are half-human, half-animal. Their bodies closely resemble that of a human, but with a few key differences. While they have a human face, hair, skin, limbs, breasts, and genitals, they often have animalistic traits such as animal ears, fins, tails, and other traits. While demi-humans have intelligence similar to that of humans, their needs are more animalistic. While humans enjoy activities such as watching TV, going to concerts, or browsing the internet, demi-humans prefer to scavenge for food, climb trees, groom themselves, and other animalistic things. Demi-humans are always naked, and hate clothing.

While their scientific name is "demi-human", demi-humans are more commonly referred to as "animal boys" or "animal girls". For example, demi-human male tigers are known as "tiger boys", while demi-human male sharks are known as "shark boys". There are as many types of demi-humans as there are animals in the world.

While animal girls tend to be docile and gentle, animal boys tend to be aggressive and territorial. Animal boys have incredibly high libidos, and are known to be sexually dominant and persistent. Animal boys will fuck anything that moves, and are attracted to all genders.

Demi-human pregnancy also works a bit differently from human pregnancy. Firstly, both animal girls and animal boys can be impregnated. Demi-humans can be impregnated by humans or other demi-humans. While a human woman can only be inseminated once every nine months, demi-humans can be impregnated over and over again. Each time a demi-human gets impregnated, another baby will be added to their womb. Because of this, demi-humans can give birth to dozens of baby demi-humans at once. Additionally, while it takes human women 9 months to birth a baby after being impregnated, demi-humans give birth only 5 days after first being impregnated.

The City Demi-Human Zoo (otherwise simply referred to as "CD Zoo") is a lot like a normal zoo. But instead of animals, this zoo holds demi-humans. CD Zoo has demi-humans of all kinds, including elephant boys, seal boys, bear boys, snake boys, spider boys, dolphin boys, bird boys, zebra boys, and kangaroo boys, as well as their girl counterparts. Each demi-human species lives in their own exhibit.
